title: What was going on
label: ch:gu-what-was-going-on
canDo: I can say what was going on and what used to happen (hũ vā̃cto hato), set a scene against an event with jyāre … tyāre, and ask what happened with banvũ (śũ banyũ?).

payoff.summary: Complete GU-R275-the-scene: set a scene, say what happened in it, and ask what happened.
